text.tspan: To:All Design, Layout, and Product Engineers
In an effort to meet the requirements for a consistent method of archiving design documents it
will be necessary for me to gather all information possible for each project being worked on at
Atari Dallas. These documents will have to come from several different sources. Documents
should be submitted in both hard copy, and on disk wherever possible. Documents should be
received from ASIC Layout, PCB Design, Hardware Design, Testing, and Product Engineering.
These documents and data files should contain the following information:
- All files and sub-directories in the project directory (SCH, SYM, TEST
• The version number of Yaron's library.
• Any simulation data and information for Mega Cells (ie Blitter).
• The View Logic and Sun OS Version used.
• A hard copy of the schematics.
- Design Layout (PCB, Gerber Files, Input Netlists)
- Design Source and Compilation Data (Routing Information)
